findings.title: Unresolved-cell marker breadth
findings.detail: On a fetch-failure unresolved row with a known role, each blank AP/entitlement/source cell renders its own 'Unresolved' marker rather than a single marker. This is within the design's documented 'visible Unresolved marker in the affected cells' wording; no change required.

findings.title: Role-direct-entitlement semantics is an inference
findings.detail: Treating Role.entitlements as role-direct and disjoint from AP-reachable leaves is a design-acknowledged ISC inference, not an SDK-documented fact. Tests run against stubbed composition, so correctness is unaffected; flagged for awareness only.
